'''Cords Cable Industries Limited''' ([[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]]: 532941, [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]]: CORDSCABLE, [[ISIN]]: INE792I01017) is the largest instrumentation [[Electrical cable|cable]] maker in [[India]].<ref>[http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/cords-cable-industries-plans-rs-85cr-expansion_434606.html CNBC-TV18]</ref>

With its headquarters in [[New Delhi]], it manufactures instrumentation cables, control cables, [[thermocouple]] cables, [[power cable]]s and  special cables for [[signal]]ing and [[electrical]] connectivity requirements, mainly for industrial use. The company manufactures cables up to 3.3 kilovolt for applications including industrial, utility and buildings. It caters to industries such as [[electric power]], [[steel]], [[cement]], [[fertilizer]]s and [[chemicals]], and [[Oil refinery|refinery]]/[[petroleum]]. The Company’s products include medium-tension control cables (up to 3.3 kilovolt), medium-tension power cables (up to 3.3 kilovolt), [[instrumentation]] cables, [[signal (electronics)|signal]] and [[data]] cables, thermocouple extension/compensating cables, panel wires/house hold wires/flexible cables, and specialty cables.<ref>[http://cordscable.com/default.php Products]</ref>

Naveen Sawhney is the [[Managing Director]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.religareonline.com/fundamental/keyofficals.aspx?CompanyCode=15050050.00&CompanyName=Religare%20Enterprises%20Ltd&MajorSector=1&Ticker=Cords%20Cable |title=Key Officials |access-date=25 January 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120308203922/http://www.religareonline.com/fundamental/keyofficals.aspx?CompanyCode=15050050.00&CompanyName=Religare%20Enterprises%20Ltd&MajorSector=1&Ticker=Cords%20Cable |archive-date=8 March 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and [[Chairman of the Board]]<ref>[https://www.google.com/finance/quote/532941:BOM Google Finance]</ref> of the company.

==Listing==
In January 2008, the Company came out with an [[Initial public offering|IPO]]<ref>{{cite news | url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2008/01/15/stories/2008011551631600.htm | archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090905071904/http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/2008/01/15/stories/2008011551631600.htm | archivedate=5 September 2009 | date=15 January 2008 | title=Cords Cable IPO price band at Rs 125-135 | work=Business Line | accessdate=20 June 2018 }}</ref> and on 13 February 2008 got listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://gujarati.economictimes.indiatimes.com/cmpnewsdisp.cms?companyID=20697&newsid=81987 |title=Listing |access-date=4 March 2010 |archive-date=13 July 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110713025110/http://gujarati.economictimes.indiatimes.com/cmpnewsdisp.cms?companyID=20697&newsid=81987 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and [[National Stock Exchange of India]].<ref>[http://www.blonnet.com/2008/02/14/stories/2008021452951700.htm Listing2]{{Dead link|date=July 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

== Rankings==
In 2008, Cords Cable Industries Limited became the only Cable manufacturer in the [[Asia-Pacific|Asia-Pacific Region]] to be listed by ''[[Forbes]]'' magazine in its 'Asia's 200 Best Companies Under a Billion List'.<ref>[https://www.forbes.com/2008/09/19/asia-best-midcaps-pf-bub08-cz_jg_0918billion_land.html Asia's 200 Best Under a Billion 2008]</ref><ref>[https://www.forbes.com/lists/2008/24/biz_bub08_Cords-Cable-Industries_KPGX.html Cords Cable's profile]</ref>

In 2012, Cords Cable Industries Limited was ranked 513th<ref>[http://www.ibtimes.com/ibt1000/search/title/Cords+Cable+Industries,+Ltd. Cords Cable Industries in IBT1000]{{Dead link|date=March 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> by [[International Business Times]] in its list, published on 16 January 2012, of world's 1000 fasted-growing companies.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ibtimes.com/ibt1000 |title=2011 IBT1000 Fastest Growing Companies List |website=[[International Business Times]] |access-date=1 February 2012 |archive-date=23 January 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120123215446/http://www.ibtimes.com/ibt1000/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Cords Cable Industries Limited (BSE: 532941, NSE: CORDSCABLE, ISIN: INE792I01017) is the largest instrumentation cable maker in India.
With its headquarters in New Delhi, it manufactures instrumentation cables, control cables, thermocouple cables, power cables and  special cables for signaling and electrical connectivity requirements, mainly for industrial use. The company manufactures cables up to 3.3 kilovolt for applications including industrial, utility and buildings. It caters to industries such as electric power, steel, cement, fertilizers and chemicals, and refinery/petroleum. The Company’s products include medium-tension control cables (up to 3.3 kilovolt), medium-tension power cables (up to 3.3 kilovolt), instrumentation cables, signal and data cables, thermocouple extension/compensating cables, panel wires/house hold wires/flexible cables, and specialty cables.
Naveen Sawhney is the Managing Director, and Chairman of the Board of the company.
